analysis.reasonEn: Wait-and-see stance maintained for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has exited oversold territory but remains consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but is still in negative territory. Volume is subdued, indicating a lack of directional conviction. A Higher Low pattern is confirmed with the 5-day and 20-day lows at 23,720. Consolidating around the swing support of 28,350.
analysis.narrative:

· 52주 위치(29.4%): 역사적 저점 대비 높은 수준이나 고점 대비 큰 폭 하락 구간
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (36.3→44.7): 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 횡보 중, 방향성 확인 필요
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-26.7549→4.5934): 음수 구간에서 개선 중, 약세 전환 신호는 아직 미확인
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 28,948원): 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 28.22%로 변동성 축소 구간
[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 (30,570원): 돌파 시 단기 반등 추세 전환 가능성
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low): 23,720원 저점 확인 후 회복 시도 구간
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.47배): 5일 평균 대비 위축, 움직임의 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 중립 구간 횡보, MACD 개선 중이나 거래량 부재. 스윙 지지선 28,350원 부근에서 관망하며 방향성 확인 필요.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 28,495) above SMA5 (KRW 26,561), below SMA20 (KRW 28,948): short-term trend turning weak, mid-term trend below
· Significantly below SMA100 (KRW 36,127) and SMA200 (KRW 36,476): maintaining strong mid-to-long-term downtrend
· 52-week position (29.4%): high relative to historical lows but significantly down from highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.3→44.7): exiting oversold, consolidating in neutral zone, directionality needs confirmation
· MACD histogram trajectory (-26.7549→4.5934): improving from negative territory, bearish reversal signal not yet confirmed
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 28,948): consolidating near the middle band, band width at 28.22% indicating reduced volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 28,350): attempting support after falling below Pivot (KRW 28,630) and SMA20 (KRW 28,948)
· Swing resistance (KRW 30,570): potential for short-term uptrend reversal if broken
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): attempting recovery after confirming the 23,720 low
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.47x): subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price action
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI consolidating in neutral, MACD improving but lacking volume. Need to observe for directional cues around swing support at KRW 28,350.
analysis.patternNote: Higher Low 패턴 형성 확인, 23,720원 저점 지지력 확인. 28,350원 스윙 지지선 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 탐색 구간.
